_comment: Our engine's family registry. The dispatcher (dispatch.py) spins up the matching backend engine per model family and swaps on change. qwen -> Strata lineage; glm/deepseek -> Maya lineage. Each backend is the proven engine launched through its own serve/server.py + venv; the dispatcher is the thin orchestrator. Backends run on their own `port`; the dispatcher fronts `front_port`.
